closedRecommendations.game: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos
closedRecommendations.thesis: Three independent expert source families converge on Corum's rushing volume. He cleared this range with 54 and 79 rushing yards in Weeks 1-2, Denver has allowed 5.1 yards per carry, and Puka Nacua's absence increases the likelihood of a run-heavier Rams plan.
closedRecommendations.risk: Kyren Williams can absorb passing-down and goal-line work; a negative game script would reduce Corum's early-down volume.
